as_told.title: Kandahar giant body loaded at Bagram

plain: A giant, said to be about 12 feet tall and taken by US forces in Afghanistan, was loaded on a cargo pallet, and the pilot who saw it said the first thing that hit him was a smell "like BO and death", and that the being had red hair, pale skin, and six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells this second-hand from an unnamed cargo pilot, placing it at Kandahar. In another version he puts the loading at Bagram Airfield in 2005 and credits Steve Quayle, a writer on giants, and a source called True Legends.
